walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the OCR GCSE Design Technology specification.

Design Thinking & Communication appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Design Thinking & Communication in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The OCR board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Design Thinking & Communication.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
